failureAnalysis.observed: Best structural program 0.735012 versus base ontology 0.859712.
failureAnalysis.mechanismHypothesis: Squarefreeness depends on detecting whether any divisor repeats. The one-bit V4B state can react to division events or divisor hits but does not retain a generic repeated-hit flag independently of another state.

failureAnalysis.observed: Best structural program 0.799760 versus strongest baseline 0.811751.
failureAnalysis.mechanismHypothesis: Möbius-positive requires both absence of repeated prime factors and even parity of distinct prime factors. One bit is insufficient to preserve both predicates simultaneously under the frozen update vocabulary.

ontogenesisCandidate.name: MULTIPLICITY_SENSITIVE_STRUCTURAL_MEMORY
ontogenesisCandidate.thesis: A generic structural program should be able to retain at least two independent pieces of divisor-sweep state, including whether repeated hits occurred and a second learned accumulator.
ontogenesisCandidate.minimumGeneralForm: Two-bit or finite-state register with event predicates FIRST_DIVISION_FOR_DIVISOR, REPEAT_DIVISION_FOR_SAME_DIVISOR, DIVISOR_COMPLETED, and LEFTOVER_PRESENT; output expression chosen from generic Boolean combinations of state bits.
ontogenesisCandidate.antiLeakage: No SQUAREFREE, MOBIUS, OMEGA, or target-specific named primitive may be included in the grammar.
